## Is Affiliate Marketing Legal? FTC Rules Every Beginner Must Follow


[Affiliate marketing is legal](https://www.reacherapp.com/blog/is-affiliate-marketing-legit-pyramid-scheme-legal-halal-and-easy-answered) in the United States, but creators and merchants must follow advertising and consumer-protection rules. The Federal Trade Commission (FTC) requires people to clearly disclose material connections that could affect how audiences evaluate an endorsement, including commission-based relationships. A disclosure does not replace truthful content: describe products accurately and do not present unverified claims as fact.


### FTC Disclosure Requirements for Affiliate Content


The FTC’s Endorsement Guides explain how disclosure applies to endorsements. If you may earn commission from a recommendation, make that relationship clear where people will see or hear it. Use ordinary language that communicates the financial connection, such as “I earn a commission if you buy through this link.” A vague label, a disclosure hidden among hashtags, or one placed far from the endorsement may not communicate the relationship clearly.


Merchants should set disclosure expectations for affiliates, provide accurate product information, and monitor promotional content appropriately. Creators remain responsible for their own disclosures and claims.


### How to Disclose Properly on TikTok and Other Platforms


Put the disclosure in the content itself, close to the recommendation. For a video, say it aloud and include readable on-screen text; for a caption or post, place it before or beside the endorsement, not after a long block of tags. Use direct wording, such as “I may earn a commission from purchases,” and check that it remains visible on mobile. A platform’s branded-content or affiliate label can add context, but do not rely on a platform tool alone when plain-language disclosure is needed.


**Do:** Make the commission relationship easy to notice and understand. **Don’t:** Assume a profile bio, unclear abbreviation, or platform label communicates the connection in every post.


### Affiliate Marketing Benefits and Risks for Merchants and Affiliates


For affiliates, this model can provide a way to earn from relevant recommendations without handling inventory or shipping. Income is uncertain and depends on audience trust, eligible actions, and program terms. For merchants, commissions can tie some marketing costs to tracked outcomes, while requiring oversight of claims, disclosures, attribution, and payouts.

Before joining or launching a program, read its terms, confirm how sales are attributed, and keep records of offers and disclosures. For legal questions tied to your campaign or business, consult a qualified attorney. Treat transparency as part of the recommendation, not an afterthought.
